objective.baseline: same Scenario and Clean-conditioned physical semantics
objective.horizon: one Repair followed by the finite K-step consequence and final W-step hold
objective.evidence_scope: raw executed Physics and Intent evidence

relations.condition: compare valid outcomes from different Physics levels
relations.left: higher level among L3 stable, L2 admissible unsettled, L1 contact invalid, L0 survival failed

relations.condition: same L1 and left is no worse on every severe item and strictly better on one
relations.left: lower expected-support no-load, unplanned-switch, and illegal-contact values

relations.condition: same L2 and left is no worse on every Recovery item and strictly better on one
relations.left: higher Capture Margin/trend and ZMP Margin, lower linear/angular momentum error and drift

relations.condition: same L3, Intent Pareto is equal, then lower repair cost
relations.left: better Intent or equal Intent with lower cost

incomparable_cases.left: L0 outcome with one failure severity
incomparable_cases.right: L0 outcome with another failure severity
incomparable_cases.reason: L0 internal priority is not human-confirmed

incomparable_cases.left: L1 outcome improving one severe item
incomparable_cases.right: L1 outcome improving another severe item
incomparable_cases.reason: severe-vector exchange has no confirmed priority

incomparable_cases.left: L2 outcome improving one Recovery item
incomparable_cases.right: L2 outcome improving another Recovery item
incomparable_cases.reason: Recovery-vector exchange has no confirmed priority

incomparable_cases.left: L3 outcome improving one Intent item
incomparable_cases.right: L3 outcome improving another Intent item
incomparable_cases.reason: Intent-vector exchange has no confirmed priority
